Name: MT-001 Sign in and sign out of a BBC account
Objective: Check a registered user can sign in from the home page and sign out again.
Precondition: A registered BBC account that you own. Do not use shared or production staff accounts.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Open the BBC home page and click Sign In.
Enter your email and password and submit.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: You return to the BBC with your name or initial shown in the header.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Open the account menu and click Sign out.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: The header shows Sign In again.

Name: MT-002 Sign in fails with a wrong password
Objective: Check a wrong password gives a clear error and does not sign the user in.
Precondition: A registered BBC account that you own.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter your email and a wrong password, then submit.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: An error says the details are not correct. You stay signed out.

Name: MT-003 A news video plays with sound
Objective: Check a video from the BBC News page plays, pauses and has working volume and captions.
Precondition: A UK or supported location, headphones or speakers on.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Open the BBC News page and click a video story.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: The video page opens with a player.
The video plays and you hear sound.
The video stops, then continues from the same point.
Captions appear and match the speech.

Name: MT-004 A live radio stream plays
Objective: Check a live BBC radio station starts and stays playing.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Open bbc.co.uk/sounds and pick a live station.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Live audio plays within a few seconds.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Leave it playing for one minute.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Audio does not stop or stutter.

Name: MT-005 Screen reader reads the home page sensibly
Objective: Check a screen reader announces the home page headings, links and menu in a sensible order.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Open the BBC home page with the screen reader on.
Move through the page by headings.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Headings are announced in a logical order.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Move to the Sign In and Register controls.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Each is announced with a clear name.
